tool.title: Loan EMI Calculator
tool.intro: Estimate a fixed monthly loan repayment from principal, annual interest rate and term.
tool.formula: For fixed-rate amortizing loans, monthly payment uses the standard annuity formula; zero-interest loans divide principal by months.
